about_the_game:
Rain down destruction from afar, and finish the job with agility and precision.

The Archer Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original delivers a well-balanced arsenal for tactical sharpshooters. Whether you specialize in long-range suppression or nimble battlefield adaptability, this gear set ensures you have the tools to outpace and outmaneuver your enemies.

Includes the following exclusive set items:

  • Guidance of Goddess (One-Handed Sword) – A sacred blade granted to warriors of unwavering purpose, offering balance and versatility in close-quarter encounters.

  • Blessing of Palkenhein (Two-Handed Sword) – A heavy, radiant weapon imbued with divine strength—reserved for decisive, sweeping strikes.

  • Bow of Rainstorm – A fast-firing bow that looses a torrent of arrows like an unrelenting storm, ideal for keeping pressure on enemies at range.

  • Time and Space Destroyer (Crossbow) – A precise ranged weapon charged with temporal energy, tearing through targets as if bending time itself.

  • Unstable Balanced Dagger – A lightweight, razor-sharp sidearm designed for swift backup strikes when enemies get too close.

Light Armor Set of Iron Will:

  • Light Helm of Iron Will

  • Light Chest of Iron Will

  • Light Leggings of Iron Will

  • Light Gloves of Iron Will

  • Light Boots of Iron Will

Tailored for mobility, this light armor offers dependable protection without compromising agility—perfect for archers who never stand still.

Command the battlefield with range, speed, and finesse. The Archer Equipment Package equips you for every situation, whether you're sniping from afar or striking in the blink of an eye.

*You must enter the game, open the premium shop and click on the DLC banner to receive the set item.

  • Processor: Pentium 4 1.6 GHZ or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel I3 6 Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
